notes: Scheduling is faster and tougher: the preview opens instantly, posts pace themselves so Buffer's rate limit rarely trips, and when it does the app waits it out and continues instead of skipping your videos. Includes everything from 2.9.47: beat drop on the cut, one-take pitch mixing, better covers, smarter scheduling, and many fixes.
_urls: urls are GitHub Release assets (stable, public, direct .exe/.dmg) and sha256 pins the exact binary - the 2.9.8+ updater verifies the download against it before offering to install. Assets use customer-friendly names (Remixa-Windows.exe / Remixa-Mac.dmg); the release TAG carries the version. Mac dmg is signed + notarized + stapled (no Gatekeeper warning) from the cloud-Mac CI. Both platforms current as of 2.9.48.
